card.text: A Cepheid in the Milky Way, 43 times the Sun's width, that swells and shrinks every 5.4 days.

sources.label: Groenewegen (2012)
sources.locator: table10, V1162 Aql: Per, Rad, Dist

introduction.text: Its mean radius, 42.7 solar radii, comes from comparing how fast its surface moves with how its size changes, 1,249 parsecs away.
